meta.title: Oh-My-BBFF Scope
meta.description: Workspace availability rules for tools, MCP servers and skills. Settings only; no additional model tools.

ui.apiTransport: No request transport available (neither fetch nor kit.postJson)
ui.boundary: Other permission layers below come from current registered-module declarations. This page does not compute their permission intersection.
ui.catalogEmpty: The catalog has no entries yet.
ui.catalogHint: Every tool, MCP server and skill known to this run, including entries workspace rules cannot manage and entries not loaded yet. No row is hidden silently; active filters are stated below.
ui.catalogNoMatch: No entry matches the active filter.
ui.caveat.mcpNoTools: MCP currently has no tools; it may be unloaded or need discovery. This is not connection health.
ui.caveat.mcpToolCount: {known} known tools, {current} currently present; some tools may require discovery first.
ui.caveat.sessionLocal: When hidden by workspace rules, Agent-owned declarations remain visible; matching calls are denied by the native execution guard. This limitation applies to every executor.
ui.diagnostic.detail.agentOwnedVisible: Agent-owned declarations remain visible; calls are guarded: {names}
ui.diagnostic.detail.tracingNoService: Agent context tracing returned no service
ui.diagnostic.newRootUnavailable: A new-root preview for this path is not available yet.
ui.diagnostic.providerUnavailable: Catalog provider unavailable; showing cached facts only. The catalog may be incomplete.
ui.diagnostic.rootCached: BBFF root unavailable; enforcing the last ROOT resolution ({at}).
ui.diagnostic.unresolvedSources: Some legacy observations have unresolved preset provenance; observed was not treated as a preset id.
ui.diagnosticsHint: Read only when expanded; never wakes a session.
ui.error.forgetRefused: Only unloaded, unreferenced observations with complete evidence may be forgotten
ui.error.previewPath: Preview cwd must be a fully qualified absolute path
ui.error.ruleKind: kind must be mcp, tool or skill
ui.error.ruleWorkspacePath: workspace paths must be fully qualified absolute paths
ui.error.rulesRevision: scope rules changed; reload before saving
ui.error.settingsRevision: Scope settings changed; reload before saving
ui.error.settingsUnknownCwd: unknownCwd must be open or hide-all
ui.error.storageBusy: Scope storage busy: {lock}; PID {pid}; lock owner was not disturbed
ui.familyUnavailable: The BBFF family root is unavailable: the records below are last known; nothing is guessed.
ui.firstObservation: Session-private tools that were never loaded and have no module declaration can only be recorded after their first appearance; recorded names are kept and still shown while unloaded.
ui.forgetHint: Removes this recorded name only; existing rules and other records are untouched.
ui.governance.familyUnavailable: BBFF root unavailable; exclusivity uses last-confirmed governance records.
ui.guidanceCwd: Scope is decided from the root session header cwd; a mid-session cd does not re-scope, so open a new session.
ui.guidanceMcp: This page does not manage MCP processes or connections; hiding affects tool visibility, prompts and calls.
ui.historyHint: Revert restores the ENTIRE rules file to before this change, including other rules; it does not undo only one selected rule.
ui.ignoredRuleHint: Names in this rule are unavailable or invalid; the rule can still be edited or deleted.
ui.incomplete: MCP server catalog may be incomplete:
ui.intro: Limit MCP servers, tools and skills by workspace. An empty path list imposes no workspace restriction. This page manages the workspace layer; module-exclusive policies and reserved transports are managed elsewhere.
ui.limitsIgnoredEverywhere: rule ignored · available in every workspace
ui.module.description: Oh-My-BBFF Scope — workspace availability rules for tools, MCP servers and skills, with a settings UI and no model tools.
ui.module.title: Oh-My-BBFF Scope
ui.name: Name
ui.noRegistry: The registry has no workspaces yet; type paths directly.
ui.noRules: No workspace rules yet. This does not override other registered permission layers.
ui.pathMatching: Paths use normalized text and directory boundaries (case-insensitive on Windows); symlink and junction aliases are not resolved.
ui.pickerBlocked: Entries workspace rules cannot manage are listed here; they stay visible but cannot be picked:
ui.presentation.helpLabel: Show effect of changing this setting
ui.presentation.invalidGroupsNotice: Basic grouping data is incomplete; the legacy flat view is retained.
ui.presentation.missingEffectNotice: Some settings have no effect text; existing descriptions or no text are used.
ui.previewHint: Pick a registry workspace or type a path and treat it as a new root session to see the entries there.
ui.previewInvalidPath: Enter a fully qualified absolute path.
ui.previewPending: Preview not ready; this is not an empty inventory
ui.previewRootHint: Preview treats that path as a new root session: it lists only entries actually present there (host, default preset and project skills), not the whole catalog.
ui.reason.hiddenUnknownCwd: ROOT cwd is unknown; hidden by Scope setting unknownCwd=hide-all.
ui.reason.invalidMcpName: Use a valid server name for an MCP rule
ui.reason.invalidSkillName: Skill names must be lowercase kebab-case
ui.reason.invalidToolName: Tool name does not satisfy the host tool naming convention
ui.reason.knownServerName: This is a known MCP server name; choose MCP or enter a full tool name
ui.reason.requiredToolHidden: {module} requires {tool}; this rule hides it in restricted workspaces: {reason}
ui.reason.sessionInactive: Session is not active; no live tools or prompt were read.
ui.seenRunHint: This run means since the BBFF catalog provider started, not this session and not a promise of callability.
ui.sessionEmpty: No live session is available right now.
ui.settings.displayLabels.description: Display names are stored in Scope settings and are restored with the default settings.
ui.settings.displayLabels.effect: Change the names shown here without changing what the rules or settings do.
ui.settings.displayLabels.label: Display names
ui.settings.rulesEntry.description: This entry only opens the rule viewer or editor; rules live in the rules file and are not a setting value.
ui.settings.rulesEntry.effect: View or create rules here; changing them changes which tools and skills are available in a workspace.
ui.settings.rulesEntry.label: Rules entry
ui.settings.showDiagnostics.description: Shows scope notes, catalog and session diagnostics in one place; when off, session diagnostics are not read.
ui.settings.showDiagnostics.effect: Show troubleshooting details; turning it off changes neither rule enforcement nor the normal view.
ui.settings.showDiagnostics.label: Show diagnostics
ui.settings.unknownCwd.description: Used only when the root session workspace cannot be resolved and no earlier resolution exists; module-exclusive tools and reserved transports are unaffected.
ui.settings.unknownCwd.effect: When the workspace is unknown, choose whether rule-managed tools stay available or are hidden.
ui.settings.unknownCwd.label: Unknown workspace
ui.standingNote: A session-private tool appears in this catalog only after that session has loaded it once.
ui.status.notPresentMissing: Can be limited by workspace (not present in this run; last seen {lastSeen})
ui.status.notPresentUnloaded: Can be limited by workspace (currently unloaded; last seen {lastSeen})
ui.status.present: Can be limited by workspace (currently present)
ui.status.reserved: Reserved {name} transport (limit the specific tools it calls)
ui.typedHint: One path per line; unregistered paths are accepted. An empty list applies everywhere.
ui.unknownSource: Source: Scope setting unknownCwd; the host supplies the factory default. Exclusive tools and reserved transports remain exempt.
